purpose: Logo didattico per il redesign iLMeteo, autorizzato dall’utente
prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: production logo for the iLMeteo educational website redesign, displayed as a square at 74px desktop and 52px mobile.
Primary request: redesign the referenced iLMeteo logo into a refined contemporary flat identity, recognizably retaining its stacked iL / Meteo arrangement. Reference image 1 is the existing logo, used only as brand reference.
Style/medium: crisp vector-like raster logo, carefully balanced geometric yet humanist letterforms. Large friendly lowercase i and uppercase L monogram in deep navy #092b60; the dot of the i is a simple orange sun disc #dc5700 with three or four restrained short rays, seamlessly integrated. Under the monogram a beautifully legible bold sans-serif word Meteo in the same navy, no serif. Compact cohesive square silhouette, optical balance, minimal padding, suitable for small-size masthead.
Text (verbatim): "iL" above "Meteo", together reading iLMeteo. Exactly this spelling, no extra words.
Backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha background.
Constraints: one single finished logo only, no presentation board, no mockup, no frame, no rounded background tile, no gradient, no shadows, no textures, no watermark. Flat navy and orange only. Keep generous counters and strong legibility at small sizes.
